stories.title: Truly Naked verzilvert zes van de zeven nominaties bij Gouden Kalveren

en.title: Truly Naked cashes in six of seven nominations at Golden Calves
en.summary: Truly Naked became the big winner at the Golden Calves, the Netherlands' major film awards, winning six prizes including best film. Joe Speedboot, which had nine nominations, won only one award.

stories.title: ‘Truly Naked’ grote winnaar bij de Gouden Kalveren met zes prijzen

en.title: 'Truly Naked' major winner at Golden Calves with six awards
en.summary: Director and screenwriter Muriel d'Ansembourg won six Golden Calves for her feature film debut Truly Naked. The series BASTA, about Marco van Basten, won the main prizes in the television category.

stories.title: Dramafilm Truly Naked en serie Basta grote winnaars Gouden Kalveren

en.title: Drama film Truly Naked and series Basta major winners Golden Calves
en.summary: Truly Naked, a drama film directed by Dutch filmmaker Muriel d'Ansembourg in her directorial debut, won six awards including best feature film and best direction at the Golden Calves ceremony in Utrecht.

stories.title: ‘Truly Naked’ grote winnaar Gouden Kalveren, ook ‘Basta’ valt in de prijzen

en.title: 'Truly Naked' major winner Golden Calves, 'Basta' also wins awards
en.summary: Truly Naked was the primary winner at the Golden Calves awards, with Basta also receiving recognition.

stories.title: Rotterdam sluit club om optreden veroordeelde rapper JoeyAK tegen te houden

en.title: Rotterdam closes club to prevent performance by convicted rapper JoeyAK
en.summary: Rotterdam authorities closed a club to prevent a performance by JoeyAK, a convicted rapper.

stories.title: Crisis in Spaanse politiek: parlement verwerpt maatregelen tegen woningcrisis

en.title: Crisis in Spanish politics: parliament rejects measures against housing crisis
en.summary: Spain's parliament rejected two government proposals to address the housing crisis, putting the government's survival at risk. The measures included eviction protections for vulnerable renters and rent freezes.

stories.title: Besluit om strengere eisen gezinshereniging ook toe te passen op ‘oudere’ zaken, houdt stand bij rechter. Migratierecht-expert is verbaasd

en.title: Court upholds decision to apply stricter family reunification requirements to older cases
en.summary: A court in The Hague ruled that stricter family reunification rules introduced in June can be applied retroactively to applications filed before their implementation date.

stories.title: Spaanse onrust over woningmarkt niet geluwd: parlement stemt tegen Sánchez’ huurmaatregelen

en.title: Spanish unrest over housing market unabated: parliament votes against Sánchez's rental measures
en.summary: Spain's parliament rejected the government's rental policy measures amid ongoing housing market concerns and public discontent.

stories.title: Rotterdam sluit tijdelijk club Villa Thalia wegens dreiging tegen rapper JoeyAK

en.title: Rotterdam closes club Villa Thalia temporarily due to threat against rapper JoeyAK
en.summary: Rotterdam's mayor ordered a 24-hour closure of club Villa Thalia after receiving concrete indications that rapper JoeyAK faced danger during a scheduled performance at the venue.

stories.title: Nederlaag voor Spaanse premier Sánchez: parlement verwerpt voorstellen om druk op de woningmarkt te verlichten

en.title: Spanish Premier Sánchez suffers defeat as parliament rejects housing market relief proposals
en.summary: Spain's parliament rejected housing proposals from the left-wing minority government, dealing a setback to Premier Sánchez and prompting speculation about early elections.

stories.title: Spaanse betogers boos omdat parlement maatregelen tegen woningcrisis afwijst

en.title: Spanish protesters angry as parliament rejects housing crisis measures
en.summary: Spain's parliament rejected two government proposals to address the housing crisis, disappointing Premier Sánchez's efforts to respond to recent public protests.

en.title: Rotterdam mayor closes venue over concert by convicted rapper JoeyAK
en.summary: Rotterdam's mayor ordered a 24-hour closure of event venue Villa Thalia following security concerns related to a scheduled performance.
